_comment: Records the published Artifact dashboard's URL so future sessions/firings can redeploy the SAME URL (via Artifact tool's `url` param) instead of minting a new one each time. See scripts/generate_dashboard.py and agents/0_orchestrator.md's 'Dashboard refresh' step.
title: @makeitmanifest — Pipeline Dashboard
description: Daily-updated status dashboard for the YouTube automation content pipeline.
hosting_decision: 2026-07-28: owner considered GitHub Pages (needs repo made public) and a Netlify git-integration deploy (works with a private repo, auto-updates on push) as ways to get a fully installable PWA on Android, but decided to just keep this as a Claude Artifact. Known limitation: on Android/Chrome this installs as a shortcut (opens in a browser tab), not a standalone-launching app, since an Artifact can't serve the separate manifest/service-worker files Chrome requires for a true install. iOS Safari's 'Add to Home Screen' behaves closer to a real app. Not something to keep re-investigating unless the owner asks again.
refresh_policy: Regenerated and republished exactly once per daily trigger firing (end of cycle), never per-item, to keep maintenance cost near-zero. See agents/0_orchestrator.md 'Dashboard refresh' step.
